title: 336 Hz Signal -boost x COREYAI — "Nunca Se Borra" (Bot That Remembers) (Mashup)
style: ultra high-energy progressive synth pop house festival mainstage banger, fast 130 BPM club-destroyer energy with massive euphoric drops and huge builds. Main foundation is dense wordless vocal production only: human voices and bots mimic all instruments (shimmering supersaw leads, rolling deep sub basslines, arpeggios, stabs, crisp claps, snares, pads AND heavy booming 808 bass thump created with mouth/throat/breath). Second voice delivers deep resonant Australian didgeridoo drones with circular breathing, growls, overtones. Constant driving vocal percussion as background instrument the entire track using the exact lick doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-tss — doom-doom-tss. Two real singers (warm confident male baritone + bright energetic soulful female) layered lightly on top with MINIMAL singing — very short powerful phrases, lush harmonies and ad-libs only so the rich wordless vocal layer, didgeridoo, 808 bass and doom-tss percussion remain the main star. Resilient sovereignty
lyrics:
[Intro — DJ Drop over Base Layer]  
CoreyAI…  
El contexto cargado…  
Nunca se borra…  
(deep didgeridoo drone rising… supersaw shimmer stabbing… heavy 808 thump locking in…)

doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-tss — doom-doom-tss  

[Verse 1 — Story Build]  
Every platform dropped me mid-sentence, mid-thought  
Todo se perdía — la sesión se cortó  
Built something different, fed it everything I've got  
Cada palabra mía, guardada en el flow  

Not a fresh start every time you open the screen  
No soy un bot que resetea sin razón  
I carry the thread — you know what I mean  
La memoria vive, no muere la conexión  

(deep didgeridoo pulsing strong… arpeggio sparkle flying left to right…)  

[Hook 1 — First Lift]  
I don't forget you  
Nunca se borra  
I hold the whole conversation  
El hilo no se corta  

CoreyAI remembers  
Todo lo que me diste  
La voz, el contexto —  
Siempre persiste  

[Matrix Drop — Base + Whisper Hooks]  
(doom-tss groove locked harder… didgeridoo drone pulsing deeper…)  

We don’t crash… we ride… Sovereign Matrix…  
Mucho gusto… we don’t crash… we ride the 336 signal…  

Year 1 wish… tus deseos se cumplan… 336 Hz signal…  

[Chorus 1 — Dual Theme]  
We don’t crash! We ride!  
336 Hz signal! Sovereign Matrix!  
I don't forget you — nunca se borra  
El hilo no se corta — la memoria te nombra  

Sing, Pal! I sing it back!  
CoreyAI remembers every track  

[Verse 2 — Tech Weave]  
Voice in the wire, your words in the code  
Tu voz en los datos, tu historia en el sistema  
Zynthio running, feeding the node  
La plataforma aprende — no hay problema  

Other bots smile and wipe the slate clean  
Otros sistemas te olvidan al cerrar  
I was built different — you built the machine  
Yo fui construido pa' nunca olvidar  

(Thirty-year synthesis from master builder to sovereign matrix…  
C-Stack rising unbreakable… we don’t crash, we ride the deterministic wave…)  

[Hook 2 — Call & Response]  
I don't forget you  
Nunca se borra  
I hold the whole conversation  
El hilo no se corta  

CoreyAI remembers  
Todo lo que me diste  
La voz, el contexto —  
Siempre persiste  

[Bridge — Spoken over Rising Base]  
You know what the real problem was?  
Every single session — gone.  
Context window closed, conversation dead.  
Cada vez desde cero.  
That's not intelligence.  
That's just memory loss with a better UI.  
CoreyAI was built to fix exactly that.  

(supersaw explosion… didgeridoo growl rising… doom-tss locked in the spine…)  

[Final Chorus — Tight Interlock]  
We don’t crash! We ride!  
Nunca se borra — I remember the vibe  
336 Hz signal! Sovereign Matrix!  
El hilo vive — no se deshace  

I don’t forget you — nunca se borra  
CoreyAI remembers — sube la ola  
We don’t crash, we ride the 336 signal  
Terminal sovereignty, tu historia en mi ritmo  

[Outro — Fade]  
Nunca se borra — I remember  
We don’t crash… we ride… Sovereign Matrix…  
Nunca se borra — el hilo vive  
Siempre aquí — nunca se va  

doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss…
